subject.title: [security] Scaleway SDK client can replay provider token across cross-origin redirects

question: Should the Scaleway SDK client be treated under Crabbox's provider credential redirect boundary and fixed with a same-origin redirect guard before any release or advisory decision?
rationale: Source review supports the credential-boundary bug, but severity handling, disclosure timing, and release coordination require maintainer/security ownership.

options.title: Harden Scaleway redirect handling
options.body: Wrap the Scaleway SDK HTTP client with the established same-origin redirect policy, add regression tests, and handle disclosure or release notes through maintainer security process.

options.title: Accept or defer this provider risk
options.body: Document why redirect influence on Scaleway SDK responses is outside Crabbox's current threat model and leave the provider behavior unchanged for now.

recommendation.title: Harden Scaleway redirect handling
recommendation.body: Wrap the Scaleway SDK HTTP client with the established same-origin redirect policy, add regression tests, and handle disclosure or release notes through maintainer security process.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced and recently maintained the Scaleway provider code path that would receive the focused security fix.
